summary: Quiet cul-de-sac kerb with homes 15-21 m away on a steep slope.
reasons: Residential street, cars park along kerb

best_section.where: Outer bend of Carnoustie Court, past the pool house, before the road drops away

drivers.seclusion: Homes sit 21 m and more from this stretch, with a non-dwelling building 15 m away; still a residential frontage on both sides.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, cars already parked along the kerb here, so room to pull in.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Parked cars visible on this stretch, but no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Steep: about 8% grade, up to 20% max nearby
Dwelling 9 m away at 64 m, just before the section
sun_shade: Mostly open; afternoon shade from trees on the north side.
